text: Shino releases hundreds of thousands of kikaichū from his body into the air. On his command, the insects attack the opponent in five waves. They then coalesce into a large cloud and rain down on the opponent, and then the insects form a giant meteor-like insect sphere crashing down on the opponent. pl:Kikaichū: Arare
Dekirh Fasthands was a jester-bard who performed in the rowdiest taverns across the Sword Coast some years before the mid-14 century DR.

While in his Level 2 Cursed Seal form, Sasuke kicks upward to launch the opponent into the air. He then glides after them and performs another flipping kick to slam the opponent into the ground, then finishes up with a Chidori. pl:Musō Gōfūjin

Konan gathers a large quantity of paper sheets into a single chakram-like shape, which she then throws at the intended target. While in flight, the disc spins with tremendous speed, with its trajectory and inclination being freely manipulated by her. This presents opportunities to attack an enemy from all angles, even if the disc is initially avoided. The discs spins so fast that a collision between the two result in a considerable impact.

Shizune first uses her Poison Mist on her opponent and then attacks with her chakra scalpels a few times. Finally, she jumps in the air and throws senbon at her opponent. pl:Strzał Igłą z Trującą Mgłą
Dela's rapier was a unique blade that once belonged to Dela Nereth, a black marker merchant and a taskmaster of the Bloodsailors gang of the Docks District of Neverwinter in the late 14 century DR.

Toneri moulds his chakra into the form of a green-coloured sphere. The sphere can be used for various purposes such as controlling targets by entering their body, rendering a target unconscious, absorbing chakra from a distance, and detonating if needed. fr:Sphère de la Marionnette Maudite pt-br:Esfera da Maldição da Marionete

By gathering dark chakra into both hands, the user can unleash a powerful and focused shock wave that, when it hits a person at close range, will cause tremendous internal damage. es:Puño de Renacimiento pl:Kasseiken pt-br:Punho da Ativação

Mecha-Naruto uses his Rasengan which is a light purple colour after propelling itself towards the opponent. As the Rasengan hits the opponent, Mecha-Naruto "shoots" his hand along with the Rasengan, further damaging the opponent.

Der Fliegende Dingbat was a ship from Klocckbarn in the Whamite Isles. It represented Klocckbarn in a series of wild conflicts between various nations and pirates of the Whamite Isles at some point prior to the mass death of the population in the .

A technique that's available to Naruto after inheriting the Sage of the Six Paths' powers. By combining his Rasengan with Shukaku's Magnet Release to reinforce its suction power, he creates a Rasengan with the beast's cursed seal markings. He then smashes the sphere into his opponent in the same manner as a normal Rasengan. Upon being struck with this technique, the markings quickly spread across the target's body and immobilises them.

The user spits out a purple breath-sphere which forcefully explodes into a stinking cloud, covering a wide area. Anyone who comes in contact with the gas gets paralysed for a short while. Furthermore, the technique can hinder the sense of smell of their victims for a prolonged period of time, as seen with Kiba Inuzuka and Akamaru. Due to this, this technique is very effective against ninken and other groups who rely on their sense of smell. The smell is due to fermentation inside the body. fr:Sphère d'Odeur pl:Sumerudama

By applying shape transformation to the orb of black flames wielded by his Susanoo, Sasuke manifests a blade in its hand for the purpose of slicing and piercing targets, thus setting them ablaze with the inextinguishable flames of Amaterasu. es:Espada Kagutsuchi fr:Épée de Kagutsuchi pl:Kagutsuchi no Tsurugi
Disarming was a weapon quality that let a weapon be used to disarm another.

Katsuyu releases an acidic paste from the mouth that, because of Katsuyu's size and height, is spread over a wide area. The acid's concentration and density is great enough to melt stone. Katsuyu requires no preparation to perform this technique, allowing it to be used instantly, which in turn means that targets have no opportunity to dodge.
Kurenai Yūhi releases a pillar of cherry petals at the opponent sending them flying.
Gengetsu forms and sends out a vortex of water, then shooting a bullet of water to massively increase the size of the vortex, swirling around the area.
Dinin Do'Urden was a drow fighter of House Do'Urden of Menzoberranzan. He later became a drider.

Hiruko used strange viscous liquid in his surrounding during the eclipse immortality ritual. He's able to manipulate the viscosity of the liquid, so he can control it. The movement of the liquid is similar to a metal spring. These chunks of liquid can hit an enemy with enough force to temporarily knock them out. pt-br:Aríete de Lodo Ultra-Viscoso

The user moulds water into the shape of a dragon, which they then direct at a target. The water crashes upon the target, dealing significant physical damage. Ideally, users will use pre-existing bodies of water for this technique, but sufficiently skilled users can instead create the water themselves, spitting the dragon from their mouths. The more talented the user, the greater the amount of water that the dragon can be made from.

Using his bubble-blower, Utakata sends a rush of bubbles toward his enemies, who are subsequently encased in a large bubble, which then appears to fill up with a black liquid. The bubble then pops in a black inky splash, obliterating them and leaving no sign of a corpse behind.
A dhow was a small sailing ship with a single, triangular sail.

Kisame slams his palm onto a nearby water surface, sending a large surge of water into the air. This water then forms into a group of four water sharks, which then rush towards the target from above. Should these sharks be attacked, the water that composes them simply reforms into countless droplet-sized sharks, which continue to rain down upon the target and inflict damage whenever they come into contact with them.

Utakata blows several bubbles at his opponent, stunning them, ending it with a single great bubble. Upon the great bubble bursting, it turns into several smaller bubbles, which coalesce into an even great bubble on top of his opponent, and floors them.
Chino gathers water into large clumps in the shape of massive orb-like formations and then drops them from the sky on to her opponents. The attack covers a large range, making it difficult to dodge.
The dire flail was a two-handed, exotic melee weapon that could be used as a double weapon.

The user concentrates their chakra into one point in their body. They use that point of their body to strike their opponent, causing severe damage. A chance of confusion also might be effected on their opponent because of the damage they have taken. es:Golpe Corporal Salvaje pl:Dzikie Uderzenie Ciałem
The user performs a suicide bomb on themselves, emitting steam from their body and then self-destructing. This technique is primarily used to keep intel obtained secret from the enemies.
Yamato causes several wood beams to erupt from the ground and reach high into the sky. They spread out and turn back down, crashing down at the opponent. They end up looking like a willow.
Dileen Shurlef was an assassin in the city of Waterdeep on the Sword Coast North in the mid–14 century DR.
Acilia is a gladiator at the Corrida Colosseum who participated in a tournament for the Mera Mera no Mi.

Big Pan is the largest former member of the Foxy Pirates and a combatant of the Groggy Monsters. He is a wotan, being half fish-man and half giant. Due to his actions, he is a major antagonist during the Long Ring Long Land Arc.
Blade is a giant from Elbaph who works as math teacher at the Walrus School.

Dhinnilith, also known as the First City of the Sword, was a phantom city rumored to appear on moonless nights every few years, hovering over the waters of the Vilhon Reach, just north of the Chondalwood.

Charlotte Moscato is the 16th son and 25th child of the Charlotte Family and the eldest triplet brother of Mash and Cornstarch. He also is an officer of the Big Mom Pirates and serves as Totto Land's , governing over Ice Island.

Charlotte Myukuru is the 25th daughter and 56th child of the Charlotte Family, the third quadruplet sister of Mobile, Marble, and Maple, and a longarm-human hybrid. She is also an officer of the Big Mom Pirates.

Colossi are statue-like beings created by the ancient tribe that resided on Waford in order to defend the Divine Breath. When a Colossus is defeated, the energy stored in its ruins is released at once, causing weather phenomena based on that element to form across the island for a short period of time. They stand in the way of the Straw Hat Pirates during their adventures on Waford in One Piece Odyssey.
The Devastating was a fishing ship owned by Captain Belyssa Erstros, a whaler from Tarmalune, one of the Windrise Ports of Laerakond.
Cibalero was the second generation on Waford. As one of the Colossi, it maintained the barrier around the Tower of Heaven. It is a secondary antagonist of One Piece Odyssey.
Damask is a pyromaniac who joined as a gladiator at the Corrida Colosseum to compete for the Mera Mera no Mi.

Hasami is a giant desert crab from Sandy Island, and a friend of Matsuge the camel. Originally an inhabitant of the deserts near Rainbase, he currently works as an employee of Ukkari Hot-Spring Island. He serves as an ally to the Straw Hat Pirates during the Arabasta Arc.

The Dirge of Delzoun was an epic dwarven ballad that told the grim tale of the shield dwarves of the North. It has never been translated from any language other than Dwarvish and was only known by a handful of dwarven bards. Over the years, only a select few elves and humans had ever heard the song performed in its entirety, a feat that would would take almost thirty hours.
Hilmungardr is a giant serpent that lives in the Land of Gods.

Ida was a giantess hailing from Samuwanai Island in the South Blue who once worked at a circus in the Bunt Kingdom. She ran a notorious bar alongside Mato in Elbaph. Ida was the unofficial mentor, advisor and long-time lover of King Harald of Elbaph, and the mother of his firstborn Hajrudin. She was also the foster mother to Hajrudin's half-brother Prince Loki, after Loki's birth mother, Queen Estrid, disowned him and died. Ida passed away fifteen years ago after being poisoned by Estrid's relatives to prevent her from claiming the fortune they believed was entitled to their family, which sent Loki into a murderous rage of revenge for his foster mother.

Joy Boy was a man from the Great Kingdom born 900 years ago at the start of the Void Century, as well as the first pirate in history. An extremely relevant figure in the Void Century, Joy Boy was a chief opponent of the alliance that would eventually become the World Government in the Great War. He played an important role in the history of Fish-Man Island and left behind a vast treasure on the last island of the Grand Line, thus becoming a legendary figure in the world. Joy Boy's Devil Fruit allowed him to transform into the legendary "Sun God" Nika, causing him to become a key part of the figure's mythos. Following his death, this Devil Fruit eluded capture for eight centuries until being consumed by Monkey D. Luffy. When Luffy awakened the fruit 12 years later, Zunesha proclaimed that Joy Boy had returned. In this form, Luffy has been given the "Joy Boy" moniker by Emet and Nerona Imu, who both personally knew the original man. He was first mentioned on the Poneglyph read by Nico Robin while at the Sea Forest.

Diana, or the Acrobat, was a monk and an adventurer from Earth and the Realm (no relation). She was a companion of the barbarian Bobby, the fighter Eric, the ranger Hank, the wizard Presto, and the rogue Sheila.
Susaburo was the second generation on Waford. As one of the Colossi, it maintained the barrier around the Tower of Heaven. It is a secondary antagonist of One Piece Odyssey.

Usodabird is a giant bird created by Dr. Usodabada. It was sent to cover various islands, one of which was Tony-Tony Island, in giant poop. It was eventually defeated by Chopperman, marking the first time that Chopperman defeated a global threat.
Captain Tomac is a giant Marine Captain that appears in One Piece Odyssey.
Determined was a huge ship owned by Pristoleph, a senator and later Ransar of Innarlith.
Urbain is a giant that Kouzuki Oden encountered in his travels.
Zaza is a mythical God of Rain who is feared by the World Nobles living in Mary Geoise.

Z ("Zed"), also known by his birth name and former epithet "Black Arm" Zephyr, was the of the Neo Marines as well as a former Marine Admiral and instructor before his resignation. He served as the main antagonist of One Piece Film: Z, in which he and his forces clashed with the Straw Hat Pirates as they were caught in midst of his Grand Reboot plan to destroy the New World. He was defeated by Monkey D. Luffy after several battles. Z sacrificed himself to protect his remaining subordinates and the Straw Hats from his former Marine students.
Dhauzimmer, also known as the Bright Blade, was a bastard sword given to the Heroes of Waterdeep by the god Lathander after recovering the Morning Light in 1358 DR.

is an omnic, and and accomplished artist. She faded out during the opening of her newest collection, which caused her to destroy five of her paintings before she was subdued by the guards; another victim of Talon's hacking.

Soundquake (also spelt Sound Quake) was a member of Overwatch. He was recruited sometime after the group's first decade of operation post-Omnic Crisis, and bolstered the group's reputation. He was equipped with chest missiles and sound technology, apparently used as a weapon.
The Sentinel is a giant, sword-wielding omnic utilized by the Shimada clan.
Diminish breath weapon was a spell that was used against dragons.
Blazehowl Noct (Japanese: シンエンオ Shin'en'o) is the element variation of Blazehowl.
Jormuntide Ignis (Japanese: アグニドラ Agnidra) is a / element Pal, and the fire variant of Jormuntide.
Katress Ignis (Japanese:クレメーナ Kuremēna) is a and elemental Pal. It is a subspecies of .
Derwin Stonecarver was a shield dwarf of Clan Ironeater who lived in Daggerford during the 13 and 14 centuries DR.
Bone Cruncher is a gargantuan found in Act 2 and Act 7. They are slow but have a strong melee attack.
Catarina, Master of Undeath is the leader of the Immortal Syndicate. She resides in the Mastermind's Lair.
Curator Miem is the vaal side area boss for the Disused Furnace, Forgotten Gulch and Evacuated Quarter. He is an Undying Incinerator.
Devil's Guile was an enchanted short sword thought to be a relic from the fields of the infinite Blood War.
Excellis Aurafix is a unique Undying based on Caliga, Imperatrix. She is the boss of .
Oak the Mighty is the map boss for the . He is based on the unique bandit, Oak.
Soul of Winter is a unique Ape that can appear from Talisman; Monkey Twins Talisman. Attributes: *Resists Elemental Damage and Chaos *Cast and Skills: * *

The Diamond Staff of Chomylla (or, occasionally, the Diamond Scepter of Chomylla) was one of the legendary lorestaves of Uvaeren, created to unlock the encrypted secrets of the ancient elven realm of Uvaeren.
The Soul of Lunaris is a Major god within The Pantheon. It is automatically captured by Sin after the player kills Lunaris, Eternal Moon at the end of Act 8.
The Eroding One is a unique Rock Golem. He is the boss of the . It also similar to the golem from .
The Great White Bones is a unique Skeletal Beast located in The Den (Act 7). It is assumed to be the remains of The Great White Beast that have been reanimated by The Bone Sculptor.
Diamond shields were a type of shield typical of the Shoon Imperium.

The Constrictor is one of the four Elder Guardians, and can be found on any map with the implicit modifier replacing the map boss. The map also has alternative icon: . The Elder will make an appearance in the map boss arena, slay the map boss, and steal its life essence. A portal will then open to the elder's domain and the players must enter through the portal. The Elder will then empower The Constrictor using the stolen life essence of the map boss, who will hatch from a black egg. Players can then enter combat with The Constrictor. Defeating The Constrictor has a high chance of dropping the which is required to fight The Elder. Such maps would also have the implicit modifier , which drop enables Elder influenced items.
Thistlesage is a unique monster located in The Imperial Gardens. He reflects both Physical and Elemental Damage. He uses Ice Spears.

Gemlings still walk Sarn, hundreds of years after the cataclysmic effects that brought their way of life crashing down around them. Caught in between life and death, these undying gemlings still have their virtue gems embedded in their flesh, beating like a second heart. They sought to propel themselves beyond the limits of humanity, and in return, they have surpassed the greatest and final limit of humanity: death--at least, natural death. These Undying stalk Sarn, believing they are living as they always had. But to an outsider, they are feral and deadly, capable of using a wide arsenal of spells in concert to demolish any who might threaten their paradise of Sarn.

Devryn Stoutt was a follower of Selûne who lived and died in the Realms, presumably in the Sword Coast region of the Western Heartlands. The records of Devrynn's death was included among other obituaries in the chapel records found within an ancient crypt of Jergal located near the River Chionthar. While the exact circumstances of Devryn's death were unknown, Devryn was known to have succumbed to the effects of fever.
This Aerodactyl, nicknamed Aero, is a /-type Pokémon owned by Red.

This Charizard is a /-type Pokémon owned by Alain and is his main partner. He picked it as his first partner Pokémon, when Charizard was a Charmander. When it Mega Evolves, it becomes a /-type Pokémon.
This Charizard is a /-type Pokémon owned by Ash Ketchum. It is Ash's fifth Pokémon and one of his strongest, winning some of his most difficult battles.
Desram was a bandit leader from the Sword Coast North, active in the 15 century DR.

This Gible is a /-type Pokémon owned by Ash. At first, Gible could not learn Draco Meteor when he and Ash were training. Most of the occasion, Draco Meteor would hit Dawn's Piplup, much to his annoyance (though seemingly unintentionally).
This Unfezant is a /-type Pokémon owned by Ash. She is the first Pokémon that Ash obtained in the Unova region.
This Hawlucha is a /-type Pokémon owned by Ash Ketchum and is the third Pokémon he caught in the Kalos region.
Despair of Athkatla was a unique fancifully-adorned enchanted wizard's staff created and wielded by Lorroakan of Athkatla in the late 15 century DR.
This Blastoise, nicknamed Blasty, is a -type Pokémon owned by Green.
This Mewtwo is a -type Legendary Pokémon that was used by Blaine and Red.
Brav is a Braviary that is one of Black's main Pokémon. He is also the second Pokémon captured by Black in the Pokémon Adventures manga's Black & White chapter; the first is Musha.
Devilish Qora was an unsavory tiefling fighter mercenary from the Lower City of Baldur's Gate in the late 15 century DR.
This Dragonite is a /-type Pseudo-Legendary Pokémon owned by Clair.
This Charizard, nicknamed Don, is a /-type Pokémon owned by Corey Demario.
This Dragonite is a /-type Pseudo-Legendary Pokémon owned by Drayton.
A Devotee's Mace was a powerful and exceedingly rare bludgeoning weapon used by celestials and mortals alike.
This Manectric, nicknamed Elec, is an -type Pokémon owned by X.
The is a Legendary Pokémon duo consisting of Latias and Latios. They were introduced in Generation III, and are native to the Hoenn region.
This Dragonite is a /-type Pokémon owned by Hiroshi Uratane.
Dhoran was a human fighter usually working as a bodyguard in the Hordelands in the mid-to-late 14 century DR.

This Charizard is a /-type Pokémon owned by Hiroshi Uratane. When it mega evolves into Mega Charizard X, it changes into a /-type, however when it mega evolves into Mega Charizard Y, its type stays normal.
This Salamence is a /-type Pseudo-Legendary Pokémon owned by J.
This Machamp is a -type Pokémon owned by the International Police.
The dervish sword was an enchanted scimitar of unknown origins found on the Sword Coast North in the late 14 century DR.

The Lake Guardians or Lake Trio are a trio of Legendary Pokémon consisting of Uxie, Mesprit, and Azelf who are the protectors of the Sinnoh region in the Pokémon anime. Team Galactic wishes to take control of them and use their powers to create a new universe in the Pokémon world. Jupiter, Saturn, and Mars were planning on bonding with them, but the trio bonded with Ash, Dawn, and Brock instead. The Team Galactic leader, Cyrus hired J to capture the lake trio so he could use them to create a whole new world.
() is a /-type Legendary Pokémon introduced in Generation V. It is a member of the Forces of Nature along with Tornadus, Thundurus, and Enamorus, and is the leader of the group.
This Dragonite is a /-type Pseudo-Legendary Pokémon owned by Lance.
Dispelling was a weapon quality that could be applied to weapons. Once per day, the wielder could use the weapon to dispel magic on whatever or whoever the weapon next touched.
This Hydreigon is a /-type Pseudo-Legendary Pokémon owned by Lance.
This Groudon is a -type Pokémon owned by Manabu Kadoo. When it primal reverts, it changes into a /-type Pokémon.
This Slugma, nicknamed Meg, is a -type Pokémon owned by Flannery.

Domineering was a magical quality that could be applied to weapons. The wielder's opponent would be forced to fight defensively against a weapon with this quality if they could not resist; they wouldn't attack as well, but were better in defense.
This Mew is a -type Mythical Pokémon that appeared in Lucario and the Mystery of Mew.
This Blaziken is a /-type First partner Pokémon owned by Meyer.
This Mewtwo is a created -type Pokémon who appears as the secondary antagonist in The Mastermind of Mirage Pokémon.
Doomwarding was a weapon quality that could be applied to magic weapons that warded off fate.
This Mew is a created -type Pokémon who appears in The Mastermind of Mirage Pokémon. It was voiced by Satomi Koorgi who also voiced Mew in Lucario and the Mystery of Mew.
This Lunala, nicknamed Nebby, is a /-type Legendary Pokémon owned by Lillie.

Nobunaga is the main antagonist of and the warlord of the -type Kingdom of Dragnor. He is a warrior whose phenomenal strength surpasses all others. Renowned for showing no mercy in battle, he is feared by all who cross his path. His subordinate is Ranmaru. He also has a striking resemblance to Cao Cao from the Dynasty Warriors series.

A diviner's staff is usually made from gnarled hazel and magically enhances the wielder's knowledge. It also contains the identify, locate creature and locate object spells, and two each of the analyze dweomer and vision spells. It is worth around 137,000 gold pieces.
This Regice is an -type Legendary Pokémon appearing in "Leaping Toward the Dream!".
This Regirock is a -type Legendary Pokémon appearing in "Looking Out for Number Two!".

This Charizard is a /-type Pokémon owned by Professor Friede and is his main partner. He picked it as his first partner Pokémon, when Charizard was a Charmander. It can Terastallize into a -type Pokémon and Mega Evolve into Mega Charizard Y.
Dmetrio Extaminos was a male yuan-ti pureblood sorcerer or fighter of Hlondeth in the Vilhon Reach in the late 14 century DR.
() is a /-type Legendary Pokémon introduced in Generation III. It is the version mascot for Pokémon Emerald. It is a member of the Weather Trio, along with Kyogre and Groudon.
This Raichu, nicknamed Raio, is an -type Pokémon owned by a Father.
The Alien Head Predator, also known as the Serpent Hunter, was an Elite Yautja from the Elite Clan. He was the most successful hunter of all time.

Divisav Irithyl was the first son of Kahvoerm Irithyl and the second of the family line to attempt to draw the Rulers' Blade and become the Coronal of Cormanthyr in . Unlike his father and all of his line to follow, Divisav failed on account of his greed and was consumed by the elfblade. He died instantly in a bout of arcane green fire. The blade was thus passed to Kahvoerm's youngest great-grandson, Sakrattars Irithyl, who become second Coronal.
Bosu is a veteran and hunter who arrived on Earth along with three other Predators to rescue a kidnapped Yautja.

Brion was an N6/MA7 Kowalski-model combat synthetic originally assigned to the Union of Progressive Peoples' Kirov Colony. Following an infestation of neomorphs at the colony, Brion was inducted into the elite unit known as the Jackals after being sold on the secondary market.

The Burning Man was an individual of the Engineer species sealed within a stasis chamber on Arcturus. During a human incursion on the planet in 2184, the Engineer was nearly roasted alive after a cult attempted to interface with his chamber.

Dolblunde was a gnomish city located in the Underdark beneath the Sword Coast North. It was abandoned as of the mid-to-late 14 century DR, and had become the lair of Daurgothoth, a mighty black dracolich known as the "Creeping Doom".

Clive Andrew Mantle (born June 3, 1957) is an English actor who played William in the 1992 film . He is perhaps best known for his role as Dr. Mike Barrett in the television series Casualty (1996-1998) and Holby City (1999-2001). Arguably Mantle's most (in)famous role was that of the first Nuclear Man in Superman IV: The Quest for Peace, a part that was completely deleted from the film before release. Mantle was to play an initial version of the charter (also incorporating elements of the comic book villain Bizarro in his take) that is created by villain Lex Luthor to defeat his arch-nemesis Superman; when Mantle's Nuclear Man is quickly beaten and destroyed by the Man of Steel in combat, Luther instead hatches a plan to create a second, more powerful Nuclear Man, who is the one seen in the finished film. The deleted scenes featuring Mantle have since taken on something of a legendary status thanks to their bizarre nature, poor special effects and unsuccessful attempts at humor, and are seen as embodying the faults of the movie as a whole. Most of the footage Mantle filmed for Superman IV has since been made available on DVD releases of the film.

An adult variant of Xenomorph XX121 spawned from the Drukathi on LV-178 were encountered by the crew of the DSMO Marion in 2159. Thanks to the DNA reflex, this variant inherited certain physical traits from its host, specifically their greater size, strength, and dog-like physical stature.

, one of the elites on BG-386.]] Elite (also called a Veteran) is the rank of a Predator who has not only completed his basic training, but has successfully killed several dangerous species, such as s, River Ghosts and Humans. This means that Elites are the general foundation of the more dangerous Predators encountered, and are most likely the reason why the Predator race is seen as close to unbeatable by the humans that are forced to face them.
The Disk of Night, also called disks of the night or disks of night, was the favored weapon of the goddess Shar, the Faerûnian goddess of darkness.
The Four-armed Predator was a massive, mutant with four arms that was dropped off on the Game Preserve planet some time after the events of .

The Fire Lizards, also called the Fire Dragons, are a hostile species that appear towards the end of Predator: Incursion. They are fearsome enough to cause the usually fearless Yautja (Predator) to flee a fight, though of course the hunters never admit to fleeing.
The First Heavy Predator was a Yautja encountered on LV-1201 in 2230.
Disruption was a weapon quality that could be added to magical weapons. It could destroy undead outright.
Gorilla Aliens were s born from Earthen gorillas. The DNA reflex granted them large arms and caused them to adopt ape-like posture and movements.

The giant hawk was a large avian native to the Union of Progressive Peoples mining planet Shānmén. When exposed to a dangerous mutagenic substance, the giant hawk would transform into a creature known as the "Raptor".

PrivateIndelicato was a member of the United States Colonial Marine Corps. He was part of a 31-Marine platoon under the command of Captain Paget, aboard the combat ship Hasdrubal that landed on the planet LV-797 under investigation of potential asset-strippers, eventually encountering an Engineer Juggernaut and a clan of Yautja defending it. Indelicato was killed after encountering an Engineer within the derelict, having his head crushed by its bare hands.
Dorhum was a dwarf fighter that volunteered to join the to-be Heroes of Waterdeep circa 1358 DR.

The Rakshasa, also known as Spring-Heeled Jack, was a lone in the nineteenth century who conducted hunts in India and England. Agent Edward Soames would be assigned by the Diogenes Club to track and kill the hunter that was terrorizing the city of London after an encounter in Bengal in 1881, fifteen years earlier. The Predator would eventually meet its end at the hands of Soames after he is drowned by him in a mud pool in the River Thames.

The "Predator King" was an old and the leader of a clan that wielded an arsenal made of vibranium, an Earth metal the Yautja called "godmetal". He had two sons, Graveyard and the Predator Prince, and he favored his older son to the point where the Prince sought revenge against his family after a hunt between the King's sons left him defeated and humiliated. The Predator King achieved his title due to him being the greatest killer of the clan, and he sought to invade Earth, kill all of its protectors, and reduce the planet to a hunting preserve. With valuable intel on the heroes and villains of Earth provided by Kraven the Hunter, a human who had earned the Yautja's respect by killing their most dishonorable member, he was able to put this plan into action. Despite being the greatest hunter in the clan and orchestrating the invasion of Earth, the Predator King was an arrogant leader that preferred to sit on the sidelines, remaining aboard his mothership on the dark side of the moon while his soldiers, his son, and his human ally provided the bulk of the invasion force. He also decided not to study Kraven's kill list of Earth's heroes and believed them to be easy prey that would give him no challenge. This arrogance and overconfidence ultimately proved to be his undoing: upon spotting the Invisible Woman of the Fantastic Four (aka Susan Storm) infiltrating his ship and attempting to overload its fusion core, the Predator King boasted of his victory to his fellow Predators befor
Robot Archie was a mechanical suit built by Dilton who used it to fend off a Predator at Riverdale high school.
Doomstrike was an item enchantment that could be applied to a weapon.
Super Predators, also known as Berserker Yautja, are a subspecies of the race. They are typically larger, stronger, and more aggressive than their smaller cousins.
A lone , known as the "Sky Devil" or "Demon", was encountered by the vigilante Superman and a S.T.A.R. Labs expedition in the Central American jungle of La Jungla De Las Sombras.

Terminator-Xenomorph Hybrid is a hybrid featured in the Aliens versus Predator versus The Terminator comic book series, a four-issue limited crossover published by Dark Horse Comics in 2000. The Terminator-Xenomorph Hybrid is the result of a deadly experiment conducted by [https://terminator.fandom.com/wiki/Skynet Skynet], the rogue artificial intelligence from the [https://terminator.fandom.com/wiki/Terminator_(franchise) Terminator universe]. Seeking to create an unstoppable force to ensure its dominance, Skynet attempts to combine the deadly efficiency of the Xenomorphs from the Alien franchise with its own advanced Terminator technology. The goal is to create a biomechanical organism that has the resilience, intelligence, and weaponry of a Terminator combined with the natural predatory instincts, acid blood, and reproductive capabilities of the Xenomorph.
Donnabella Fiasco was a spellcaster who lived in the region of the Sword Coast North near Phandalin during the late 15 century DR.
Wolverine, born James Howlett and more commonly known by his alias Logan, was a human mutant who fought against the .
This unnamed Giant is the wife of Dale, and the mother of their unnamed son, she appeared in the episode "Meeseeks and Destroy".

Dagon, also known as Dagon the Deep and Father Dagon, is is one of the two major antagonists of the comic series "Rick and Morty vs. Cthulhu". He is elder god of the Deep Ones, who rules the sea and made Morty Smith his adopted son.

Don-Jon Raskin was a human miner and retired adventurer active around Neverwinter and the Sword Coast North in the late 15 century DR. He was hired to oversee the Mountain's Toe gold mine in the northern foothills of the Sword Mountains.
High Voltage Morty is a Scissors-type Morty in Pocket Mortys. He evolves from Static Morty, and evolves into Electrokinesis Morty.

is one of the antagonists that appear in the Season 6 episode, “Full Meta Jackrick”. He is a member of the Self-Referential Six in Meta Reality. When he shoots a beam from the gem on his headband, it turns a into the protagonist of the show.

Predators, also known as the Yautja, are a species of alien that are from the Predator franchise. They were first mentioned in Rick & Morty's Thanksploitation Spectacular where one of the turkey-hating aliens gave The President a gun, saying they got it from a Predator. In Mort: Ragnarick, The Pope traded a Predator 3 muskets for a communication device for Bigfoot. The only Predator to appear in the Rick and Morty franchise is Gul'Karna, Clan Leader of the Skin Thieves, who is hired by Mr. Poopybutthole in How Poopy Got His Poop Back.
Doomthresher was a double-headed flail that was the weapon wielded by the avatar of Urogalan, the halfling deity of earth and death.

The Spectre of Undeath is one of the many minor characters in the "Rick and Morty: Rick's New Hat" comic series and "Rick and Morty (comic series) (Second run)" comic series. They are one of the gods who was once killed by Rick Sanchez and was subsequently locked in Anti Hala.
The Merchant, also known as The Newt, is a non-killable NPC located in the Bazar Between Time
OCP Crime Prevention Unit 002, also known as RoboCable, was a cyborg police officer, secretly created by OCP's Security Concepts from the remains of deceased police officer John T. Cable.
Distorting cloth armor was a type of enchanted cloth armor, used in the 15 century DR.

RoboCop refers to a number of comic book series spun off from the feature film of the same name. The main character is a fictional cyborg -Detroit police officer who begins as a human police officer Alex J. Murphy, who is killed in the line of duty by a vicious crime gang. Subsequently, Murphy is transformed into the cyborg entity by the mega-corporation Omni Consumer Products. Since his 1987 film debut, the RoboCop character and franchise have been exercised through numerous entertainment media, including multiple comic book mini-series and ongoing series.

Known since ancient times, witches are a race on the boundary between human and monster. They live in harmony with nature deep within the woods, far from any human habitation. It is said that they are able to use magic by harnessing the power of nature.
A doomblade was a magical sword which held a captured demon.
Yuki-Onna (Snow Women) (called Snow Fairies in the Viz translation) are one of the numerous Yōkai types that can be found in the Rosario + Vampire universe.
Senjin Chouka (Thousand Blades Funeral Flowers) is a summon of Xia-Long Miao, which he refers to as his "trump card".
Boxy (ボクシー, Bokushii) is a bird-winged Monster who is the second of the Seven Great Monsters. He is trapped inside the orange Rainbow Crystal and is reborn inside a Priest.
Diseased was an enchantment that caused a weapon to inflict a wasting disease.
Blizzar (ブリザー, Burizaa) is the 3rd Monster created by Kunzite. She is created when Kunzite turns Saeko Yamamoto into a monster to find out who Sailor Moon is.
Kurumiwario is the 4th Lemures that was sent by Fish Eye to fight the Sailor Guardians, and this was during his attack on Yamagishi.
Kyurene (キュレネ, Kyurene) is a humanoid vampire bat-like Monster summoned by Jadeite in order to drain energy in episode 6.
The dominion rod was the control mechanism for the hollow of dominion, a massive artifact that could exert psychic control and madness over the southern Sword Coast North.
"Moon Crystal Power, Make Up" is the 2nd command that Usagi Tsukino uses to transform into Sailor Moon in the manga, anime, and Sailor Moon Crystal.

"Neptune Planet Power, Make Up" is the 1st command used by Michiru Kaiou to transform into her standard, regular Sailor form as Sailor Neptune in the manga, and the only one shown to be used in the 90s anime series.

Metalia Endymion (メタリア エンディミオン, Metaria Endimion) is a name given to the entity formed when Prince Endymion absorbed Queen Metalia's power within himself in an attempt to seal it away but was instead corrupted by it. This character was only seen in Pretty Guardian Sailor Moon.
Doom hammer was an enchanted maul, a "bringer of that which it is," found in the Western Heartlands of Faerûn in the late 15 century DR.
Saeko Yamamoto is a renowned skier who only appeared in the anime series. She was transformed into the youma, Blizzar, by Kunzite.

"Sailor Princesses" are Sailor Guardians who have castles of their own and realms they are charged with defending. In their Princess Forms, the Senshi wear a dress unique to them and can wield great power.

Eredas was a protoss warrior, left wounded in stasis with two others on Aiur after its evacuation. He was the only survivor of the three when the Fist of Ulrezaj attacked the expedition sent to rescue them. He emerged as a dragoon. Transported back to Shakuras along with the captive Fist of Ulrezaj members by Zeratul, he was last seen defending Shakuras from a raid by Schezar's Scavengers.
Doming hammers were a type of metalworking tool often used in armor-crafting, resembling a double-headed hammer.
The Elite Dragoon is an elite protoss warrior "sold" by Crazy Bob's Bazaar.

Gestalts are terran ghosts, spliced with protoss parts to become a hybrid of the two races, created by experimentation on the former species by Project Gestalt – a black ops research program under the Terran Dominion. Gestalts had unspecified psionic abilities, including the ability to use psionic blades. Project leader Doctor Stanley Burgess intended to have them access the Khala and use energy shields as well. Grafting templar-grade psionic appendages to them increased their psionic abilities and combat potential. The Dominion sought to mass-produce these creatures in preparation for conflict against the zerg and protoss. They would be controlled by neural conditioning and neural inhibitors. The project came to an end, with the sole existing specimen, Gestalt Zero, breaking free of his neural inhibitor and working with the protoss.
High templar are protoss warriors that use powerful psionic powers to support other protoss forces.

Dorn was a common dwarven and half-orc male first name. It could also refer to: *Dorn Black Axe, a dwarven warrior from the Cavern of Cloven Heads *Dorn's Deep, a dwarven stronghold in Icewind Dale *Dorn Graybrook, a human half-golem *Dorn Heldeion, a member of Oeble's Council of Nine Merchants *Dorn Il-Khan, a half-orc blackguard *Dorn Redbear, a human barbarian *Dorn Strongcroft, a dwarven tunnel worker *Hamminas Dorn, the Lord Speaker of Tarmalune

The hybrid destroyer is a type of protoss/zerg hybrid. It is primarily based on the former species, sometimes referred to as a "hybrid protoss." It is a powerful, sentient being wielding psionic and void-based powers.

Hybrid Experiment 9E57 was a Moebius hybrid created by Moebius Corps. It was thought that should it reach full power, there would be no stopping it from destroying the planet it was created on. It was augmented with terran technology, and created alongside Hybrid Experiment A626 and Hybrid Experiment 523I. General Carolina Davis called on the aid of two allied commanders to aid her in destroying it, and with the prototype Archangel the Balius, Davis and the commanders were able to destroy it before it could reach full power.
Karass was a protoss high templar. His mastery of psionic powers was considered legendary.
Dornavver, also known as Demonbane, was a legendary weapon of Faerûnian history. It was a sword wielded by heroic paladins and the kings of Impiltur, and it was famous in the fight against fiends.

Karl was a ghost of the Terran Dominion before being recruited by Project Shadowblade. His identity was restored and thanks to terrazine exposure, his psionic powers intensified. During the Spectre Rebellion, he took part in a mission to Korhal Palace under the command of fellow spectre Gabriel Tosh. The mission was to assassinate Arcturus Mengsk. However, it failed due to the intervention of Agent Nova Terra. Karl was killed during the conflict, and his death weighed heavily on Tosh.

Kinetic blast is a psionic power demonstrated by Sarah Kerrigan during the Second Great War. Using the ability, Kerrigan was able to send a burst of psionic energy to a target, dealing massive damage to a single enemy.
Kraith was a primal zerg pack leader on Zerus and leader of Kraith's Pack. According to Zurvan, Kraith was "immense and consumed by hatred."

Doryn No-Mouth was a male human and one of the four staff of The Rapids inn in Teshwave in 1367 DR, working as a stableboy and handyman. He was a young, fair-faced lad of around 17 years, but he was mute. Doryn was frequently harassed by the Zhentilar because of his particular condition, and they called him "Doryn No-Mouth". However, he was very observant and had the ability to read and write, a skill that the Zhents were not aware he possessed. Tula Woodsbridge looked out for him.

Ma'lash was a Tal'darim highlord. Brutal, dangerous and unyielding, he was said to be favored by Amon himself, even being called the "Blade of Amon." He wore a red mask and was considered the most powerful of the Tal'darim.
Lab Specimen U-23A is an ultralisk that was shackled and researched by Terran Dominion scientists within the Castanar installation.
General Martin is the leader of a mercenary company known as Martin's Marauders, leading them personally in a siege tank. His forces are famous for their "Iron Golem" goliaths.
Dorring Brightaxe was a dwarf fighter in Daggerdale around 1479 DR.

Mertick the Mauler was a vicious protoss archon mercenary. He served a faction which Infested Stukov considered to be an enemy and "detestable vermin." Mertick was killed and his forces destroyed by mercenaries hired by Stukov.

Corporal Miles "Blaze" Lewis is a veteran firebat of the Terran Dominion, and formerly a member of Raynor's Raiders. A pyromaniac, Lewis has seen his fair share of battles against both the zerg and protoss. Unlike many firebats, Lewis isn't a resocialized criminal, doesn't smoke, and dislikes the smell of napalm in the morning. He has had training for covert missions.

Molten salamanders are large burrowing life forms native to Veridia Prime. They have long, serpent-like bodies, and can spew acid. Molten salamanders are considered to be an endangered species. When the forces of Amon invaded the planet during the End War, a molten salamander named Molten Sal began attacking a nearby terran settlement, but would only appear during the planet's lava surges.
Draa velve, meaning "two sword", was a fighting style taught among drow. It involved wielding two weapons at a time.

Psionic shocks are psionic energy cast from the exterior of one's body and delivered to a target. Against organics, it shuts down an organism's brain temporarily without any lasting damage. Nova is one such individual with this ability. This ability was also demonstrated by hybrid destroyers such as Maar, though the hybrid's version is more deadly.

Sagaya was a Nerazim stalker and commander of the Daelaam. He served in the One-Day War. In the early stages of the conflict, Sagaya was chief ground-force commander for the Daelaam forces on Gystt. When his forces moved to the second adostra nest, they were ambushed by a large zerg brood under the control of the chitha. Sagaya's Stalker body was heavily damaged in the fighting and the he was rendered unconscious. Though support came in from Terran Dominion forces under Colonel Abram Cruikshank, the zerg tide was still too substantial. Cruikshank initially thought that the Nerazim was dead already, but his presence woke Sagaya and they managed to hold a brief tactical conversation. Cruikshank offered help but Sagaya's Stalker frame was unable to operate and the Nerazim himself was too badly injured. Allowing Cruikshank to retreat, Sagaya ordered a nearby disruptor be detonated, which destroyed both the zerg attackers and the adostra nest. Sagaya was killed in the blast, and only three of his warriors survived. His second in command, Commander Rahas, replaced him.

Dorn Black Axe was a dwarf warrior who resided in the Cavern of Cloven Heads, a rich iron mine in the Underdark. He was the only known member of Clan Black Axe, and a renowned "Brave Beard".

is a Japanese actor, voice actor and singer affiliated with Aoni Production. His major roles include Byakuya Kuchiki in Bleach, Treize Khushrenada in Mobile Suit Gundam Wing, Hisashi Mitsui in Slam Dunk, Meisuke Nueno in Hell Teacher Nūbē, Kunimitsu Tezuka in The Prince of Tennis, Alucard in Castlevania, Zero in Mega Man X, Yuu Matsuura in Marmalade Boy, Shigure Sohma in Fruits Basket, Dark in D.N. Angel, Toriko in Toriko and Kokushibo in Demon Slayer: Kimetsu no Yaiba. As a singer, he was one of the members for Entertainment Music Unit from 1995 to 2000. He is married to voice actress Ai Maeda. His range is A～E♯ and his dialect is Osakan. His older sister is an animator. He is the official voice-over dub for Scott Foley, Taylor Kitsch, Lin Gengxin and Stephen Fung.
Emergency Destructive Form is a move used by Alisa Bosconovitch in Tekken 8.
Gon with the Wind or Dino Wind, known in Japan as , is an attack performed by Gon in the PlayStation version of Tekken 3.

The dragon blade was a magical greatsword from Rashemen whose origins and creation were associated with silver dragons. It possessed a powerful enchantment and was particularly deadly in the hands of those individuals who entered into frenzies or rages while in combat.
Gatling Combination is a move used by Bryan Fury since Tekken 5.
Phoenix Bone Breaker is a move used by Paul Phoenix since Tekken 4.
Overflow to Boot is a move used by Alisa Bosconovitch since Tekken 7.

Dragon breath, or breath weapon, known in Draconic as frahraek, (svaerx in Tymantheran) was a term used to refer to a special ability that was inherent to dragons and the majority of dragonkind, even those who merely had draconic ancestry.
Sasquatch Cannon is a move used by Craig Marduk since Tekken 6. True Ogre also uses this move in Tekken Tag Tournament 2.
Session to Destructive Form is a move used by Alisa Bosconovitch since Tekken Tag Tournament 2.

Eve is a T-799, the prototype for the Series 800 Terminator. Eve is developed by Skynet to ensure its survival on August 29, 1997. On this date in Skynet's World, Miles Dyson and his colleagues conspired to shut down Skynet. Eve entered the compound at Cheyenne Mountain to protect the AI from its impending doom.
Draga Salt-Biter was an infamous pirate of the Sword Coast that later became the darklord of Saragoss, one of the many Domains of Dread.
Eliza is a T-X Terminatrix originally intended to be sent to the past by Skynet, however, it was captured and reprogrammed by the Resistance.

Seven is the seventh T-101 Infiltrator constructed by Serena Burns in 2001. Working in a Secret Terminator Lab constructed under the old Dyson property with the assistance of Third, the process of creation was advanced beyond previous unit's due to mission requirements. Extra tissue accelerant was introduced into this unit's matrix during growth. Decanted from matrix chamber with a full array of head, facial and body hair, and the physical appearance of a weather-beaten mid-to-late 30's. With the creation of Four through Seven, Serena realized that the simultaneous presence of identical units would compromise infiltration, and initiated a protocol of radical cosmetic alterations to defer suspicions. Seven was provided a Desert Eagle .50, Cyberdyne-issued identification as Security Specialist Dick Lewis and carried concealed weapon permits.

A Hybrid, also known as a T-H or Theta, is a human who has been transformed into a cybernetic organism. It is the main focus of Project Angel, which was initiated by the Genetics Division of Cyberdyne Systems, and reborn by Skynet as Project Theta.
Dragon bow was an enchanted longbow rumored to be imbued with the spirits of Chultan dragons.
The I-990 Hybrid Infiltrator, formally Cyberdyne Systems I Series Specialist Infiltration Unit, is a human/Terminator hybrid.

:"My CPU is a neural-net processor; a learning computer." :- T-800 - The Cyberdyne Systems is a "learning computer" and one of the most powerful microprocessors ever built. All of the battle units deployed by Skynet contain a Neural Net CPU. Housed within inertial shock dampers within each battle unit, the CPU gives Skynet the ability to control its units directly, or allow them to function independently, learning from a pre-programmed knowledge base as they go. This means that each battle unit has the potential to adapt to its situation, and literally reason through problems and tactical maneuvers. In the case of the various Terminator series, this means that they can learn to behave more like humans in order to be better equipped for infiltration. When delegated by Skynet for autonomous tasks, the unit in question is place under a "read-only" preset; this means that they cannot adapt beyond the needs of their assigned mission nor go beyond what their mission parameters allow. Properly removing the microprocessor would result in the shut-down of the particular unit it belonged to, making it the "soul" of the unit. The device was developed by Miles Bennett Dyson, director of Special Projects at Cyberdyne Systems Corporation, via reverse engineering on the of a T-800 Terminator in 1984.

The "One Eyed Monster" was a nickname given to a T-600 Terminator that was in operation in Alaska in 2018. This unit was named so because of damage it sustained against a bear in the wilderness. The machine engaged the Resistance units in the region and single handedly destroyed a Resistance base in the area. It was destroyed by Molly Kookesh after she caused the unit to step out onto a frozen river, which, because of its weight, broke through the frozen layer and into the icy waters below.

Draalim was one of the Blades of the Old Man as of . He was a small Calishite, who often posed as a merchant throughout the Sword Coast. He took a vigil on the night of Tarsakh 19 on the orders of the Old Man of the Mountain at the Garden of Winged Horses in Sentinelspire. By the next day, his remains were found on the Star Fountain. Identification was not completely conclusive, but he wasn't seen again.
"Pops" is a T-800 Terminator and Model 101 Infiltrator sent from an unknown time in the future. Acting as 's Guardian, Pops' mission is to protect her from termination.
The "Prison Guard Terminator" is a T-600 deployed as a prison guard.

T-831 HCC-18 Heavy Combat Chassis Unit is a variant of the Series 800 Terminator developed by Cyberdyne systems. The T-831 is a heavily enhanced Combat chassis, making it more dangerous than a Hunter-Killer. In addition, the T-831 unit is programmed with Skill Upgrade: Marksman.
Dragon brace and fang was the title given to a mighty shield and its companion short sword, both of which were sized for a halfling.

The T-90 is a Terminator Endoskeleton a type of Humanoid Hunter Killer in several timelines and it is an equivalent to the T-800 Endoskeleton from most of the timelines. Skynet used the T-90 as the basis to develop the T-101 Infiltrator, a machine encased in a living tissue outer sheath.

The Cyberdyne Systems Series 700 Infiltration Unit,, also known as the 700 Series or simply T-700, is a Terminator that served as an infantry unit along with the T-600 and T-800. The T-700 is also one of the first true Infiltrators, serving as the stepping stone between the T-600 and T-800. The Resistance referred the T-700 as the "Dog-Killer".

The T-950 is an advanced variation of the T-900 Terminator produced by Skynet. The T-950 is an alleged "bridge" from the T-900 to the T-X as it is an Infiltrator with living tissue over a hyperalloy-armored endoskeleton like a T-900 while possessing reconfigurable arms, housing various weapons as a T-X does.
Dragon Sight was an enchanted helmet that granted the wearer a temporary simulacrum of a dragon's magic sight.
The T-950 Terminator was a T-950 Infiltrator that traveled back in time to assassinate John Connor.
The T-950 Terminatrix is a reprogrammed T-950 Terminatrix / Infiltratrix that traveled back in time to protect John Connor.
The T-720 is a variant of the T-700 series Terminator in Genisys timeline that was produced in 2022.
The doublecross bow was a drow repeating light crossbow found between worlds in the mid-1480s DR.
The T-8000 is an upsized and heavily-armed Terminator developed by Skynet, possibly based on technology reverse engineered from Cybertronians in the Transformers vs. The Terminator timeline.

The T-K90, or Cyberdyne Systems Series K Misdirection Infiltration Unit, also known as "Labrador Deceiver", was a canine-looking infiltrator created by Skynet when it realized the Resistance was using dogs to sniff out Terminators.
The T-660 Cyberdyne Systems Series 600 Infiltration Unit, or T-660, also known as "Ragdoll", was an Infiltrator built by Skynet in the RPG timeline.
The Dragon's Claw was a ship that sailed the Sea of Fallen Stars. Jomo Shanbaeren once stowed away on this vessel.
The Cyberdyne Systems Series 700 Infiltrator Unit, or T-770, also known as "Data Junkie", is a specialized variant of the T-700 Terminator model.
The T-R80, formally T-R80 Series R Reconnaissance Infiltration Unit, also known as "C-Bats" or "Cyberbats," is an Infiltrator used by Skynet 2.0.
The Cyberdyne Systems Series 700 Heavy Combat Chassis Unit, or T-731, known as "Heavy" among the Resistance, is an advanced iteration of the T-700 model.
The Dragonjaws' Bounty was a mercantile ship from either east or northeast Faerûn that operated in the Sea of Fallen Stars around 1370 DR.
The Cyberdyne Systems Series 800 Optimal Infiltration Unit, or T-881, is an advanced variation of the regular T-800.

T-101 is a Humanoid Hunter Killer. *In the NES game The Terminator, a T-101 is a Terminator, which is the machine sent to kill Sarah Connor in 1984. (See also: T-800) *In T2: Infiltrator, a T-101 Infiltrator is T-90 Humanoid Hunter-Killer with living tissue outer sheath, utilized to infiltrate human groups. *In the Terminator 3: Rise of the Machines film, a T-101 Terminator is a Terminator with a Model 101 living tissue outer sheath.
Unit number 675/45, aka "Uncle Bob", is a T-800 Terminator sent back to help John Connor become the leader of the Resistance.
Dragonheir Clans was an Abeiran book that chronicled the story of the Dragonheirs of the Sword Lands, and recorded the genealogy of every Dragonheir clan that had existed.
